title: Customisable Multi-Layer Cache IP
summary: A configurable multi-layer cache IP core for Vivado, parameterised for size, associativity, and layer count. Inspired by my recent work on caches in a RISC-V CPU.
thumb_alt: Diagram of a CPU core connected through a growing L1, L2, and L3 cache hierarchy to main memory

title: L-LUT to P-LUT Synthesis
summary: A Python and SystemVerilog toolflow decomposing large lookup tables into FPGA-ready 6-input LUT networks, with SystemVerilog netlist and testbench generation.
thumb_alt: Icon of a binary decision tree representing Shannon decomposition of a truth table

title: PYNQ-Zoom
summary: Real-time FPGA fractal renderer: 48 parallel Mariani-Silver cores on a PYNQ-Z1, 36x faster than the ARM baseline. Built the memory subsystem, BRAM-to-DRAM streaming pipeline, queue system, top-level control, and RTL test suite.
thumb_alt: Diagram of recursive quadrant subdivision used by the Mariani-Silver fractal algorithm

title: PYNQ-Cast
summary: Multiplayer first-person raycasting engine on a PYNQ-Z1 FPGA with a cloud-hosted, cloud-authoritative game server; built the HDMI output protocol and hardware UI overlay.
thumb_alt: Illustration of a raycasting-rendered frame with vertical wall slices

title: Multithreaded Chat
summary: A multithreaded client-server chat system in C over UDP, with GTK and command-line clients, chat rooms, and message history replay. Built as a duo project.
thumb_alt: Diagram of a multithreaded chat server routing messages to global, room, and private channels

title: Unix Shell
summary: A functional Unix shell in C implementing pipelines, redirection, subshells, and history expansion. Built as a duo project.
thumb_alt: Diagram of a terminal window showing a shell prompt, a piped command, and a fork/exec process tree

title: RISC-V CPU
summary: A pipelined RISC-V RV32I processor in SystemVerilog with a multi-level cache hierarchy. Built the fetch stage, memory subsystem, cache/MMU, and verification. Built by a four-person team.
thumb_alt: Abstract illustration of a CPU chip package with pins
